_about: Hand-kept half of the chunk catalog: what each training chunk is and what each experiment that isolated a chunk measured. harness/nnue/chunk_catalog.py merges this with the GPU queue's job records (which chunks each network was trained on) and the files' sizes. Add a chunk here when it is made; add an experiment when a network that differs from its base by known chunks has been measured. Every generated chunk added from 2026-10-06 carries a recipe (book, starts, play_nodes, label_nodes, seed, flags, machine, made): the same fields for all, so sets can be compared and recombined. Matches named LADDER-* are 600 games on 0.3.6's engine, 40,000 nodes a move, balanced_200.
